supplier.description: Supplier/vendor name, distinct from receivedFrom for detailed accounting use cases.

createdAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

updatedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

receivedDate.description: Canonical UTC instant for the calendar day the book was received, serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix. Writers store midnight UTC of that day; the time-of-day component is insignificant. Same convention as library.defs#progressLogEntry.date.

catalogTarget.description: The work, and edition, this acquisition is about.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice or receipt number, for tax/accounting reference. Implies invoiceAvailable: true.

acquisitionType.description: How the actor came to own this edition.

catalogSnapshot.description: Point-in-time work/edition metadata capture, refreshed from current catalog data at write time.

priceMinorUnits.description: Price in the currency's minor units (e.g. cents for EUR/USD), not a float. Zero is valid and meaningful (distinguishes a recorded free copy from no price recorded, which is this field absent).

invoiceAvailable.description: Yes/No/unset - field absence means "unset". Must be true when invoiceNumber is set.

main.description: A record of how an actor came to own a specific book edition (purchased, gift, review copy, etc.). Multiple acquisitions per edition are allowed; like library.marker, library.review, and library.state, this record uses key: "tid", and its rkey is an opaque identity that never changes.
